children: Silver Crown Royalties Inc. increased its non-brokered private placement to up to approximately C$11M from up to approximately C$5M, at C$35.00 per share. Closing is expected on or before November 30, 2026, subject to conditions.
Placement raised to up to approx. C$11M from C$5M
The larger raise increases potential funding, but also the amount of equity issued; proceeds are intended for working capital and royalty acquisitions.
Up to 314,286 shares at C$35.00 each
The issuance may dilute existing shareholders; the release provides no comparison with the current share count.
Closing expected by Nov. 30, 2026, subject to conditions
Funding is not yet secured; completion depends on customary conditions, including Cboe Canada acceptance.
Insider participation is expected, but the release gives no participation amounts.
Post-closing cash expected to exceed C$18.9M
This is a forward-looking estimate conditional on closing, not a reported current cash balance.
